steps.command:
cd /workspace
pwd
ls -la
find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\n'

cd /workspace
file main.db main.db-wal
xxd main.db | head -40
echo '--- WAL ---'
xxd main.db-wal | head -60
echo '--- strings db ---'
strings -a main.db
echo '--- strings wal ---'
strings -a main.db-wal | head -100

cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
src=Path('main.db-wal').read_bytes()
dec=bytes(b^0x42 for b in src)
Path('main.db-wal.fixed').write_bytes(dec)
print('decoded header:', dec[:32].hex(' '))
print('frames count:', (len(dec)-32)//(4096+24))
PY
ls -la
xxd main.db-wal.fixed | head -25
sqlite3 main.db "PRAGMA journal_mode; SELECT * FROM items ORDER BY id;" 2>&1 | head -50

cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import struct
b=Path('main.db-wal.fixed').read_bytes()
ps=struct.unpack('>I',b[8:12])[0]
print('page size',ps,'size',len(b))
off=32
i=0
while off+24<=len(b):
    h=b[off:off+24]
    print(i, 'off', off, 'pgno',struct.unpack('>I',h[0:4])[0], 'dbsize',struct.unpack('>I',h[4:8])[0], 'salt',h[8:16].hex(), 'cksum',h[16:24].hex())
    off+=24+ps
    i+=1
PY
# backup original corrupt WAL and install fixed one
cp -n main.db-wal main.db-wal.corrupt
cp main.db-wal.fixed main.db-wal
sqlite3 main.db "PRAGMA journal_mode; SELECT * FROM items ORDER BY id;" 2>&1 | head -100

cd /workspace
ls -la
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3, json
con=sqlite3.connect('main.db')
rows=con.execute('SELECT id, name, value FROM items ORDER BY id').fetchall()
print('rows:', rows)
data=[{'id':r[0], 'name':r[1], 'value':r[2]} for r in rows]
with open('recovered.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print('count:', len(data))
PY
cat recovered.json
